q.t: Deba makes one mark on the wall for each cow that goes out. He makes 9 marks. How many cows went out?
q.e: One mark stands for one cow, so 9 marks mean 9 cows.

q.t: How many letters are there in the word ‘tiger’?
q.e: t-i-g-e-r: count one by one, 5 letters.

q.t: Which animal has the longest name (the most letters)?
q.e: ‘elephant’ has 8 letters; the others have only 4.

q.t: Which animal has the shortest name (the fewest letters)?
q.e: ‘ox’ has just 2 letters; the others have 4.

q.t: How many letters are there in ‘seventeen’?
q.e: s-e-v-e-n-t-e-e-n: 9 letters.

q.t: Which of these needs electricity to work?
q.e: A fan has a motor that runs on electricity; the others just sit there.

q.t: Which one does NOT eat food?
q.e: A doll is not alive, so it does not eat. Cats, parrots and cows do.

q.t: Which is the number name of 43?
q.e: 43 is 4 tens and 3 ones: forty and three.

q.t: Mahesh and Kartik — who has the longer name?
o: Both have the same number of letters
q.e: M-a-h-e-s-h has 6 letters and K-a-r-t-i-k has 6 letters too.

q.t: 7 cows went out, so there are 7 marks. As cows come back, 7 marks are struck out. Did all the cows come back?
o: Yes, all the cows came back
q.e: Each cow that came back struck out one mark. No mark is left, so no cow is missing.

q.t: Deba made 15 marks in the morning. In the evening, 12 marks were struck out. How many cows are still outside?
q.e: Each mark left on the wall is a cow that has not come back: 15 − 12 = 3.

q.t: How many letters are there in ‘forty-three’? (Do not count the dash.)
q.e: ‘forty’ has 5 letters and ‘three’ has 5 letters: 5 + 5 = 10.

q.t: How many more letters does ‘elephant’ have than ‘lion’?
q.e: ‘elephant’ has 8 letters and ‘lion’ has 4: 8 − 4 = 4.

q.t: Which number name has exactly 8 letters? (Do not count the dash.)
q.e: ‘fifty’ (5) + ‘six’ (3) = 8. ‘twelve’ has 6, ‘seventy-seven’ has 12, ‘one’ has 3.

q.t: Which is the odd one out?
q.e: Apple, mango and banana are fruits; a carrot is a vegetable.

q.t: Hemant has 36 cows and 23 sheep. He makes one mark for each animal. How many marks does he make?
q.e: One mark per animal, so add them: 36 + 23 = 59.

q.t: Which number name has the most letters?
q.e: ‘seventeen’ has 9 letters; ‘fifteen’ has 7; ‘twelve’ and ‘eleven’ have 6.

q.t: Names in a group: Asha, Amit, Bina, Arun, Babu. How many names start with A?
q.e: Asha, Amit and Arun start with A — that is 3.

q.t: Names: Ravi, Rita, Sona, Raju, Sam. Which starting letter is used the most?
q.e: Ravi, Rita and Raju start with R (3 names); only 2 start with S.

q.t: How many letters are there in ‘twenty’?
q.e: t-w-e-n-t-y: 6 letters.

q.t: Riddle: I am between 30 and 40. My number name has two words. The second word has 5 letters and ends with ‘n’. Who am I?
q.e: Thirty-___: the 5-letter words are three, seven and eight. Only ‘seven’ ends in n, so it is 37.

q.t: How many letters are there in ‘ninety-nine’? (Do not count the dash.)
q.e: ‘ninety’ has 6 letters and ‘nine’ has 4: 6 + 4 = 10.

q.t: ‘fifty-six’ has 8 letters. Which other number name also has 8 letters?
q.e: ‘forty’ (5) + ‘two’ (3) = 8. ‘fifty-five’ has 9, ‘sixty’ has 5, ‘seventy-one’ has 10.

q.t: 24 marks were made in the morning. In the evening 20 marks were struck out. Later 3 more cows came home and 3 more marks were struck out. How many cows are still missing?
q.e: Marks left = cows still out: 24 − 20 = 4, then 4 − 3 = 1.

q.t: Rita sorts 12 toys into ‘things with wheels’ and ‘things without wheels’. 5 toys have wheels. How many have no wheels?
q.e: Every toy goes into exactly one group, so the two groups together make 12: 12 − 5 = 7.

q.t: Which roll number has a number name with exactly 5 letters?
q.e: ‘seven’ has 5 letters. ‘eleven’ has 6, ‘thirteen’ has 8 and ‘ten’ has 3.

q.t: Four friends are called Ib, Asha, Gopal and Venkat. How many letters are in all four names together?
q.e: Ib 2 + Asha 4 + Gopal 5 + Venkat 6 = 17.

q.t: Which list goes from the shortest name to the longest name?
q.e: Om has 2 letters, Ravi 4, Sunita 6 and Gurpreet 8.

q.t: How many numbers from 1 to 99 have a number name with only 3 letters?
q.e: Only one, two, six and ten have 3 letters; every other number name is longer.

q.t: In a class, 6 children have one ponytail, 4 have two ponytails and 5 have short hair. How many children are there?
q.e: Every child is in exactly one hair-style group, so add the groups: 6 + 4 + 5 = 15.

q.t: Deep makes one mark for each cow and each goat that goes out: 18 cows and 9 goats. In the evening, 25 marks are struck out. How many animals are still outside?
q.e: Marks made = 18 + 9 = 27. Marks left = 27 − 25 = 2, and each mark left is an animal still out.

q.t: Teji’s roll number is 43 (‘forty-three’). Jojo’s roll number is one more. How many letters are in Jojo’s number name?
q.e: One more than 43 is 44, ‘forty-four’: 5 + 4 = 9 letters.

q.t: Which number name has the most letters?
q.e: ‘seventy-seven’ has 7 + 5 = 12 letters; ‘eighty-eight’ has 11, ‘twenty-four’ 10, ‘ninety-one’ 9.

q.t: Riddle: I am between 60 and 70. My number name has 9 letters, and my second word starts with ‘n’. Who am I?
q.e: ‘sixty’ has 5 letters, so the second word has 4. Four, five and nine have 4 letters; only ‘nine’ starts with n.

q.t: Hemant makes marks for his 36 cows in groups of five. How many full groups of five does he make?
q.e: 7 fives make 35, which is 1 short of 36. 8 fives would be 40 — too many.

q.t: In a class, 12 names begin with a vowel (A, E, I, O, U) and 19 names begin with another letter. How many more names begin with another letter?
q.e: ‘How many more’ means find the difference: 19 − 12 = 7.

q.t: Ravi says, ‘Every animal name with 4 letters has an o in it.’ Which name shows that Ravi is wrong?
q.e: ‘deer’ has 4 letters but no o. One example that breaks the rule is enough to show it is wrong.

q.t: How many of the number names from 11 to 19 end in ‘teen’?
q.e: 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 19 end in ‘teen’; eleven and twelve do not.

q.t: Asha’s name has 4 letters, Bina’s has 4 and Charu’s has 5. Dev’s nickname has as many letters as Asha’s and Charu’s names together. How many letters is that?
q.e: Only Asha and Charu are counted: 4 + 5 = 9.

q.t: 23 cows went out and 23 marks were made. When they came back, marks were struck out until 5 were left. Later 3 more cows came back. How many cows are still missing?
q.e: 5 marks left means 5 cows out. 3 come back and strike 3 marks: 5 − 3 = 2.
